# RC Web Solutions LLC

> Custom websites and web applications for small service businesses, built and maintained by one developer, Randy Caballero. Based in Houston, TX, working with clients anywhere in the US. Next.js, React and TypeScript. Bilingual English & Spanish.

## About

RC Web Solutions LLC is a one-person web development company based in Houston, Texas, founded by Randy Caballero in September 2022. It builds fast, custom websites and web applications for small service businesses (clinics, HVAC, home services, event rentals, salons) with booking, Stripe payments and local SEO built in. Most clients so far are in the Houston area; Randy works remotely with clients anywhere in the US through video calls, an online staging site and Stripe payments. Every project uses a modern stack (Next.js, React, TypeScript) and includes mobile-first design and bilingual (English/Spanish) support.

- [Website](https://www.rcweb.dev/)

## Founder

Randy Caballero is a full-stack developer with 6+ years of experience building React and Next.js applications. He founded RC Web Solutions LLC in September 2022 and has shipped 20+ production sites for small businesses, most of them in the Houston area, handling frontend, APIs, databases, deployment, analytics and paid acquisition. Previous roles: Software Developer at Atser Systems Inc. (2024-2025), Software Developer at Revature (2022) and Frontend Developer at Empresa Agropecuaria de Camagüey (2015-2017). Education: B.S. in Software Engineering (Universidad de Camagüey), M.S. in Education (Nova Southeastern University) and a Doctor of Education (EdD) in progress at Nova Southeastern University.

- [LinkedIn profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/caballerorandy/)

## Services and Pricing

"From" prices are quoted after a free call; the final price depends on the scope. Every project includes source code ownership, domain and hosting setup, training, local SEO and bilingual (English/Spanish) support.

- [Professional Landing Page Development](https://www.rcweb.dev/services/web-design-houston) — from $1,000. Single page focused on conversions. Delivery: 1-2 weeks. 30 days of support.
- [Professional Business Website](https://www.rcweb.dev/services/web-design-houston) — from $3,000. 5-10 pages with custom design. Delivery: 3-4 weeks. 30 days of support.
- [Website Redesign and Modernization](https://www.rcweb.dev/services/web-design-houston) — from $3,500. Transform an outdated website with content migration and SEO preservation. Delivery: 4-6 weeks. 45 days of support.
- [Custom Business Management Dashboard](https://www.rcweb.dev/services/nextjs-development-houston) — from $7,500. Tailored admin dashboards for business operations. Delivery: 5-6 weeks. 60 days of support.
- [E-Commerce Website Development](https://www.rcweb.dev/services/ecommerce-houston) — from $8,000. Full online store with Stripe payment processing and no monthly platform fees. Delivery: 6-10 weeks. 90 days of support.
- [Custom Web Application Development](https://www.rcweb.dev/services/nextjs-development-houston) — from $12,000. Custom platforms with authentication, databases, APIs and integrations. Delivery: 8-12+ weeks. 6 months of priority support.
- [Monthly Website Maintenance and Support](https://www.rcweb.dev/services/seo-local-houston) — from $200/month. Security updates, performance monitoring, content updates, local SEO and technical support.

## Technology Stack

Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Docker, AWS, MongoDB, MySQL, Zod, Zustand, Stripe, Resend, Cloudinary

## Payment Structure

50% deposit to start, 50% on completion, paid securely through Stripe (credit or debit card). Payments work worldwide.

## Development Process

1. Discovery (Week 1) — Requirements analysis, competition research, detailed proposal and transparent quote
2. Design & Planning (Weeks 1-2) — Wireframes, application architecture, tech stack selection and timeline
3. Iterative Development (Weeks 2-5) — Weekly sprints, Friday demos, continuous testing and real-time adjustments
4. Launch & Support (Week 6) — Secure deployment, training, documentation and post-launch support

## Key Differentiators

- Bilingual (English/Spanish native), serving Houston's Hispanic community
- Latino-owned business in Houston, TX
- Modern tech stack (Next.js, React, TypeScript)
- Transparent pricing: 50% deposit, 50% on completion, no hidden fees
- Private project link with milestone tracking for every client
- Websites load in under 2 seconds
- Local SEO built into every website
- Clients keep full ownership of the source code

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Do you work with clients outside the USA?
A: Yes. Projects are fully remote using Zoom and Slack. Payments through Stripe work worldwide.

Q: How long does a typical project take?
A: Landing pages: 1-2 weeks. Business websites: 3-4 weeks. Admin dashboards: 5-6 weeks. E-commerce: 6-10 weeks. Web applications: 8-12+ weeks.

Q: Do you offer post-launch support?
A: Yes. Every project includes complimentary post-launch support: 30 days for landing pages and business websites, 45 days for redesigns, 60 days for dashboards, 90 days for e-commerce and 6 months for web applications. Optional maintenance starts at $200/month.

Q: How does payment work?
A: 50% deposit to start, 50% on completion, paid through Stripe.

Q: Can I see progress during development?
A: Yes. Weekly progress updates, a private project link with milestones, staging access and 24-hour response time.
